title: Clinozy Competitor Intel
subtitle: 16 competitors in 3 tiers (Top, Medium, Peer; Clinicea appears in both Medium and Peer) seen through 4 lenses: what they do well, what Clinozy is missing, where Clinozy can stand out, and the psychology behind their features. Click a row to see user reactions, the psychology and the code check.
callout: Code check. Several sources treat a two-way WhatsApp inbox as Clinozy's biggest edge. In the code today, WhatsApp and Instagram messages are queued but not delivered. The messaging service is reserved and nothing reads it yet (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258), so staff reply through wa.me links. The edge is real only once delivery ships.

takeaways.p: None of the 5 top-tier leaders has a native two-way WhatsApp inbox. Clinozy queues these messages but does not send them yet, so shipping sending comes first.
Support and lock-in: Zenoti's 12–24 month contracts, HealthPlix at 2.8/5 on G2. Offer human WhatsApp support and cancel any time.
Leaders price in USD per practitioner or hide prices. Peers anchor at ₹3.5k–15k a year. Flat INR per branch, GST included, sits between them.
Deposits through UPI payment links, a sendable quotation, memberships and a wallet, a public booking link.
Expiring packages (loss aversion), wallet balance (endowment), progress cards (goal-gradient), a review request after the reveal (peak-end).
Machines as bookable resources, a pharmacy with batches and MRs, the Today floor board, priced treatment plans and next-offering ideas.

footer: Sources: reviews on G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, Google Play and Software Advice (mostly from search snippets, because review pages were blocked from this session), plus vendor sites. Rows marked unverified rest on vendor claims or analysis. The psychology rows are analysis. Built with the competitor-intel skill.
